messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hello,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 14 00} {07 00 00}Think
this rain{01 00 00 05 00} will ever let up,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
You think{01 00 00 05 00} if I ditch my
umbrella and just run
between the raindrops...
{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}...I'll stay dry?{01 00 00 14 00} {07 0e 00}If I was a
little skinnier, I wouldn't
have to run much!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Tere,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 14 00} {07 00 00}Kas
see vihm{01 00 00 05 00} kunagi

Mis sa arvad{01 00 00 05 00}, kui viskan

{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}...kas jään kuivaks?{01 00 00 14 00} {07 0e 00}Kui

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}What should I have for my
after-dinner beverage
tonight?{01 00 00 14 00}{07 14 00} RAIN, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}Heh heh heh!{01 00 00 0a 00} And it's all
you can drink, too!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{0b 03 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Mida võtta täna õhtul
pärast sööki
joogiks?{01 00 00 14 00}{07 14 00} VIHMA, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}Heh heh heh!{01 00 00 0a 00} Ja seda saab
juua nii palju kui tahad!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{0b 03 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}It was a dark and stormy
night.{01 00 00 14 00} A lone figure stood
alone in the downpour{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{07 00 00}
{07 0a 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Heh heh heh!{01 00 00 0a 00} It's like the
opening to a really good
bad movie,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.

{07 14 00}I think the only things
awake at this hour{01 00 00 0a 00} are you,{01 00 00 0a 00}
me,{01 00 00 0a 00} and all this rain{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}It's nice that I don't have
to make small talk with
either of you,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Arvan, et sel kellaajal on
ärkvel ainult sina,{01 00 00 0a 00} mina{01 00 00 0a 00}
ja{01 00 00 0a 00} kogu see vihm{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Tore, et ma ei pea

ajama,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Good evening{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
This rain is really
something, {04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}It's great for me,{01 00 00 05 00} since I
didn't have time to take a
shower today.
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Tere õhtust{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
See vihm on küll midagi,
{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}Mulle sobib see hästi,{01 00 00 05 00} sest
